concept.title: Defroster
concept.shortdesc: The vehicle is equipped with a defroster for removing frost or fog from the rear window.

conbody.p: To defrost or defog the front windshield, refer to Windshield defrosting and defogging.

note.p: To prevent damage to the conductors bonded to the inside surface of the rear window, never clean the window using sharp instruments or window cleaners containing abrasives.

section.title: Rear window defroster
section.p: The defroster heats the window to remove frost, fog, and thin ice from the rear window while the vehicle is in ON position.
If there is a heavy accumulation of snow on the rear window, brush it off before operating the rear defroster.
To turn the rear window defroster on:

li.p: Press the rear window defroster icon located in the heater control panel.
The indicator on the rear window defroster icon appears when the defroster is on.
The rear window defroster automatically turns off after approximately 20 minutes, or when the vehicle is in OFF position.
Press the rear window defroster icon again.

section.title: Outside mirror defroster
section.p: If your vehicle is equipped with outside mirror defrosters, they will operate when you turn on the rear window defroster.
